name: I Cannot Die
description_html:
Lightweight survival insurance mod for SPT. Unlike traditional “god mode” mods, it intelligently manages your health to keep you in the fight without breaking the game’s core mechanics or server stability.

Key Features

  • Vital Protection: Prevents death by ensuring your Head and Chest never fall below 1 HP.
  • Smart Damage Capping: Uses low-level ChangeHealth patching to intercept lethal damage before it occurs, keeping your vital organs “red” but never “blacked out.”
  • Server Stability: Bypasses hardcoded “un-restorable” vital organ logic. This prevents the common System.Text.Json errors on the SPT server when saving your profile after a raid.
  • In-Game Configuration: Full support for the F12 Menu (BepInEx Configuration Manager). Toggle the protection on or off instantly during a raid.
  • Numerous situations have been tested: falls from great heights, grenade explosions, barbed wire, multiple injuries from wild groups and PMCs.
